title: About

header.title: Hey there, I'm Chris.
header.subtitle: A freelance web developer and software engineer.

aboutContent: Hey, I'm Chris Dekker. I'm %age% and work as a software engineer and mobile app developer in The Netherlands. I've been into programming since I built my first website at 14. With over 8 years of experience in web development and DevOps, I'm always up for a new challenge. I enjoy blending work with travel, meeting new people, and diving into new learning experiences. If that sounds like a match, let's connect and create something awesome together!
